Mazenchu is set in a school where all kinds of food can live out their youth and form friendships, rivalries, and bittersweet romances.

(Source: ANN)

data.title: Funbarus
data.synopsis:
The anime centers on Nossori the sloth, who always works hard for humans and idly listens to their casual conversations. Those conversations in turn fuel Nossori's wild imagination.

(Source: ANN)

data.synopsis: A series of shorts featuring TV Osaka's mascot character Takoru-kun which are broadcast at various times throughout the week.

data.title: Chikyuu Daisuki! Kikkun
data.synopsis:
Kikkun, an extraterrestrial life form, came from a distant planet to invade Earth. However, the invasion team members assigned in Japan end up finding the country comfortable and now want to protect Japan and Earth, forgetting their original motive.

(Source: ANN)

data.title: Yuruyuru Zukan
data.synopsis:
Gakken's hugely popular illustrated encyclopedia series, which everyone can enjoy with its laid-back four-panel comics, is finally being adapted into a TV anime!

Discover surprising aspects and fun facts about living creatures—full of secrets that will make you say, "Wow!"

Enjoy this new kind of anime that makes even scary things fun and easy to watch, with its cute art style.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

titles.title: ゆうさんち！from 遊ハち

data.title: Yuusanchi! from Yuu-hachi
data.title_japanese: ゆうさんち！from 遊ハち
data.synopsis:
Yuu-hachi's Dekai Hachi; Miseban no Spis; and Aa, Tanuki wa Mou Dame desu manga all adapted into an omnibus short anime.

Dekai Hachi centers on a the titular character, a 40cm tall creature and his daily life alongside humans. Miseban no Spis centers on a mysterious fish that suddenly appears one day. Aa, Tanuki wa Mou Dame desu centers on a tanuki that is rented by various people.

(Source: ANN, edited)

data.title: Papan Ga Panda!
data.synopsis: A series of shorts broadcasted on Kids Station. The star a Panda (with other animals present) as they do quick skits usually revolving around singing, dancing, and exercise.
data.background: The characters are also frequently used in commercials for various companies. The series is most notable for being the official mascot of Okayama Toyopet, a Japanese Toyota car dealership.

data.title: Origami Ninja Koyankinte
data.title_japanese: おりがみにんじゃ コーヤン＠きんてれ
data.synopsis: Koyan, the Origami Ninja, came to Earth from his planet Origamio to find the magical stone "Hapiton" that has the ability to make people happy. On the way, he was joined by childhood friend Namin anda new friend Lublin. One day, a villain called Evilrun appeared. Evilrun has a black hole in her stomach and tries to inhale anything. Every time an event happens, Evilrun gets in the way of Koyan and friends. But what Evilrun's aim is remains a mystery...
